errorCodes.meaning: No slot the caller may manage has this `mnemonic`. Returned alike for a slot that does not exist and for one the caller does not own, so the code cannot be used to learn which slots exist.
The submitted `domain` is not a known hosting domain on this consumer. See [category conventions](../../../_shared/0.1/CONVENTIONS.md#2-unknown-domain-error).

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Resolution.description: `auto`: the hosting service's own policy decides, typically by the slot's traffic; this clears any override. `fine`: always keep the finest series the service offers. `coarse`: never keep the finest series, only the coarser ones. `off`: keep the slot's totals only, and no series over time.

changed.description: `false` when `previousResolution` already equalled the requested resolution.

previousResolution.description: The resolution this request replaced; `auto` when none was set.

resolution.description: The resolution now set for the slot.

tier.description: The detail the service keeps for the slot as of this response. Under `auto` it can change later with the slot's traffic or the service's policy.

tierReason.description: Why `tier` applies: `override`, this slot's resolution; `policy`, a service-wide setting that applies to every slot; `traffic`, the service's automatic choice from the slot's activity.

schema.description: Sets how much statistical detail the hosting service keeps over time for one slot. The outer document members are owned by the framework (SPEC §6.3).

domain.description: Disambiguates `mnemonic` per the category conventions. Absent means the domain is resolved by the category's chain.

mnemonic.description: The slot whose statistics resolution is set.

resolution.description: The resolution to keep for this slot from now on. Declarative: requesting the resolution already set succeeds and changes nothing.
